from pathlib import Path
import re,json,sys
p=Path.home()/".config/systemd/user/prediction-a2z-v4-model@.service"
if not p.exists():
    print("E132=SERVICE_TEMPLATE_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(31)
txt=p.read_text(errors="replace")
def field(name):
    vals=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        if line.startswith(name+"="):
            vals.append(line.split("=",1)[1])
    return vals
out={
 "working_directory":field("WorkingDirectory"),
 "exec_start":field("ExecStart"),
 "environment":field("Environment"),
 "environment_file":field("EnvironmentFile"),
 "type":field("Type"),
 "timeout_start":field("TimeoutStartSec"),
 "success_exit_status":field("SuccessExitStatus"),
 "mentions_campaign":"FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4" in txt,
 "mentions_instance":"%i" in txt,
 "mentions_tick":" tick" in txt or " tick " in txt,
 "mentions_supervisor":"supervisor.py" in txt,
 "mentions_request":"requests/" in txt,
}
print("E132_SERVICE "+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":")),flush=True)
if out["mentions_instance"] and out["exec_start"]:
    print("E132=INSTANCE_SERVICE_USABLE_FOR_TIMER",flush=True); raise SystemExit(0)
print("E132=SERVICE_TEMPLATE_NOT_TIMER_SAFE",flush=True); raise SystemExit(20)
